phase: Accounting Empirical Recovery / F7 Phase B — Exact Aggregate-Control Rank Audit

exact_aggregate_complements.rule: These are aggregate-sector complements from W0 total minus all other published resident-sector aggregates. They are not bilateral cells and are not materialized into the Accounting Spine.

scientific_interpretation: Stock F7 has 13 available aggregate equations but exact coefficient rank 11; flow has 11 equations and rank 10.
No bilateral coordinate is invariant across the unconditional nullspace for either stock or 2025 flow.
The stock domestic asset/liability identity is exact at retained precision and the 2025-flow residual is about -0.01 million RON, inside the existing 0.1 million RON tolerance.
Two missing aggregate sector controls can be recovered only as aggregate complements: stock C liabilities and flow G assets. They do not identify counterpart allocation.
Zero aggregate G/BNR controls are not converted into bilateral zeros and no non-negativity or issuer-applicability premise is imposed.
F7 is economically non-zero at aggregate level but bilateral structure is unidentified at the tested public-data boundary.

disposition.accounting_recovery_next_priority: Reassess full Accounting Spine readiness and explicit remaining reopen conditions for F2/F4/F5/F6/F7/F8

reopen_F7_when: A definitionally comparable official source provides bilateral F7 or additional exact counterparty constraints sufficient to reduce the unconditional nullspace.
